the use of LABs as a molecular marker in marine sediments is a promising tool for the study of sewage effluent and its impact on coastal ecosystems.

LABs are not a good indicator of sewage effluent or sewage pollution in Narraganset Bay.

the use of LABs as a molecular marker for sewage effluents in marine environments is a useful tool, however, care should be taken to use the most appropriate methods to minimize the impact of the extraction, purification, or quantification methods on the final data.
